importFormats.auto: Option of the Format picker: the format is detected from the content.
importFormats.http: Option of the Format picker for files with the .http extension. Keep .http.
formatLabels.insomnia: Name of the kind of file found, shown in the import summary. Keep the product name.
formatLabels.har: HAR is a recorded set of browser requests. Keep HAR.
formatLabels.wsdl: WSDL describes a SOAP web service. Keep WSDL.
import.chooseFiles: Button that opens a file picker.
import.importButton: Button that imports the chosen content.
import.chooseFolder: Button that opens a folder picker.
import.dropHint: Lists supported formats. Keep product and format names.
import.pastePlaceholder: Placeholder of the text area for pasted content.
import.pasteLabel: Accessible label of the text area for pasted content.
import.pastedName: Name used for pasted content in the summary, where files are listed by name. Short, lower case.
import.reading: Status text while the content is being read.
import.skipStatic: Checkbox for imports from a HAR capture: ignore requests for static files.
import.skippedHeading: Heading above the list of requests that were not imported.
import.tooLarge: {{name}} is a file name, {{size}} and {{limit}} are sizes such as 2.5 MB.
import.totalTooLarge: {{limit}} is a size such as 20 MB.
import.noFiles: Error shown when a chosen folder holds nothing that can be imported.
import.clearFiles: Button that removes the chosen files.
import.sourceLine: One line of the import summary. {{source}} is a file name, {{label}} is the kind of file, {{counts}} is a phrase such as 3 requests and 1 folder.
import.totalLine: {{counts}} is a phrase such as 3 requests and 1 folder.
export.includeSecrets: Checkbox. Credentials are passwords, tokens and keys.
export.secretsNote: {{placeholder}} is written with double braces, for example a variable name in capitals. Keep it unchanged.
export.secretsWarning: Warning shown when credentials are included in the export.
export.saveFile: Button that saves the export to a file.
export.formatLabel: Accessible label of the format picker.
export.previewLabel: Accessible label of the preview box.
export.summaryNamed: {{description}} is a sentence fragment without final full stop describing the format, {{name}} is a collection name, {{counts}} is a phrase such as 3 requests and 1 folder.
export.summaryAll: {{description}} is a sentence fragment without final full stop describing the format, {{counts}} is a phrase such as 3 requests and 1 folder.
export.collectionField: Label of the picker that chooses which collection to export.
export.formatField: Label of the picker that chooses the export format.
export.allCollections: Option meaning every collection is exported.
export.failed: {{reason}} is a technical message. Keep it unchanged.
export.adaptFailed: {{reason}} is a technical message. Keep it unchanged.
export.reportLabel: Accessible label of the list of differences for the target tool.
export.checkHeading: {{tool}} is the name of the program that will read the export, for example Postman.
export.changedHeading: {{tool}} is the name of the program that will read the export, for example Postman.
export.formats.gostman.description: Fragment that follows the format name. No final full stop.
export.formats.html.description: {{example}} stands for a variable written with double braces. Keep it unchanged.
export.docs.titlePlaceholder: Placeholder of the title field. The default title itself stays in English.
export.docs.playground: Checkbox: add an interactive panel to the generated page where visitors can try requests.
transfer.title: Title of the dialog that groups import, export and share.
transfer.tabsLabel: Accessible label of the tab list.
transfer.tabs.share: Tab for creating a share link.
importCount.collection: Counted noun in the import summary, for example 2 collections. A collection is a top-level folder.
importCount.global: Counted noun: a global environment, shared by every collection.
importCount.variable: Counted noun: a variable that belongs to a collection.
importCount.holding: {{collections}} is a phrase such as 1 collection, {{inside}} is a phrase such as 3 requests and 2 folders.
importCount.settingsFor: {{owners}} is a phrase such as 1 collection or 2 folders. Settings are headers, auth and scripts.
importResult.quoted: Wraps a name in quotation marks. Use the quotation marks of your language.
importResult.scopedEnvironments: {{names}} is a list of collection names in quotation marks. The singular form refers to one collection.
importResult.scopedVariables: {{names}} is a list of collection names in quotation marks. The singular form refers to one collection.
importResult.importedCollectionName: Default name of a collection created to hold imported items. Saved as the folder name.
importResult.settingsAttached: {{names}} is a list of collection names in quotation marks.
importResult.settingsWrapped: {{name}} is the name of a new collection.
fileReads.heading: Introduces a list of file paths that an imported request reads from this computer.
fileReads.more: Last line of a truncated list of file paths.
activeImport.kindLabels: Noun phrases used in a list, for example scripts and OAuth 2.0 settings. They appear as the object of "carry" in the question before import and in the "left out" sentence when several kinds are listed, so a form that also reads after a colon (for example "Left out: ...") is fine.
activeImport.titleOne: Title of the question before import when one kind of item is affected. One message for each kind, so the article and the case can agree with the noun.
activeImport.titleMany: Title of the question before import when several kinds are affected.
activeImport.withOne: Button that imports everything. One message for each kind of item that is affected; the noun is the object of "with".
activeImport.withMany: Button that imports everything including the risky items.
activeImport.withoutOne: Button that imports without the risky items. One message for each kind of item that is affected; the noun is the object of "without".
activeImport.withoutMany: Button that imports without the risky items.
activeImport.leftOut: Used when several kinds were left out. {{kinds}} is a list of noun phrases such as scripts and OAuth 2.0 settings of different grammatical gender, so a form with a colon (for example "Left out: {{kinds}}.") avoids agreement problems.
activeImport.message: {{count}} is a number of items, {{kinds}} is a list of noun phrases. Scripts run when a request is sent, so they are risky.
transfer.tabs.import: Tab name for bringing data into Gostman. Noun or verb, whichever is the shorter tab label.
transfer.tabs.export: Tab name for taking data out of Gostman. Noun or verb, whichever is the shorter tab label.
activeImport.leftOutOne: Sentence shown after the user chose to import without the risky items, when exactly one kind was left out. One message for each kind, so the verb and article can agree with the noun.
